game.title: Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days
game.blurb: Action shooter from IO Interactive (RAWG also lists Square Enix), published by Square Enix, released 2010-08-17. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the Story Mode missions the Steam achievements name, plus co-op, Arcade Mode, multiplayer and the Doggie Bag achievements.

chapters.title: Welcome to Shanghai to Coming Home
chapters.summary: The first five missions named in the achievements: Welcome to Shanghai, The Details, Blood, Sweat and Tears, Laying Low and Coming Home.

chapters.title: A Thousand Cuts to Resurrection
chapters.summary: The later missions named in the achievements: A Thousand Cuts, The Deal, Out of Shanghai, Air Strike and Resurrection. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Story Mode and Extreme
chapters.summary: Finishing Story Mode, finishing it on Extreme, and a mission without dying once.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Missions and the full Story Mode with a partner, reviving them and finishing off enemies they put down.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Human shields, exploding canisters, pistol, shotgun and headshot streaks, fighting while downed and the 1000-kill total.

chapters.title: Arcade Mode
chapters.summary: Escaping with the loot, reaching later rounds, penalty-free streaks and career money goals that also count in Arcade Mode.

chapters.title: Ranked Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Fragile Alliance, Cops & Robbers and Undercover Cop goals in Ranked Matches. Needs a network connection, if the servers still run.

chapters.title: Doggie Bag
chapters.summary: The achievements tagged [Doggie Bag]: canister kills, escaping on every level, fast escapes and career goals, mostly in Ranked Matches.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4477). Steam app 28000 ("Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days") is the only store-list match; its schema is named "ValveTestApp28000" (a placeholder name). None of the 58 Steam achievements is hidden. RAWG's detail says 120 achievements, far more than Steam's 58. The mission chapters use the ten mission names in the achievement descriptions; nine follow Steam list order (which also falls steadily in unlock percentage), and "Resurrection" sits near the end of the Steam list, so putting it last is our own guess from its 30.7% unlock rate (between Air Strike and finishing Story Mode). Achievements that count in either Arcade Mode or a Ranked Match were put in the Arcade chapter so they can be done offline. The nine "[Doggie Bag]" achievements have their own chapter; kaneandlynch.fandom.com has a page named "Kane & Lynch 2: The Doggie Bag", but what it contains was not checked. StrategyWiki has no page under "Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days", "Kane and Lynch 2: Dog Days" or "Kane & Lynch 2". kaneandlynch.fandom.com answers the API under "Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days" with about 38 linked articles (including "Arcade Mode", "Fragile Alliance", "Cops & Robbers", "Undercover Cop" and a "Kane and Lynch 2: Dog Days Walkthrough" page); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
